Leaving deletes the routines and to-dos in the category linked to this house. Rejoining won't bring them back.
Your contribution history in the house stays.

Delete the '{{title}}' mission?
Contribution history stays, but the mission leaves the list. Your linked routine is deleted too; other members' routines are only unlinked.
